item.title: Revealing the Proton Slingshot Mechanism in Solid Acid Electrolytes through Machine-Learning Molecular Dynamics
item.description:

Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Machine-learning molecular dynamics reveals a proton slingshot mechanism in solid acids: limited polyanion rotation plus O–H reorientation enables long-range proton jumps, refining the Grotthuss picture. It links polyanion rotation, proton coordination, and transport, showing proton concentration controls rotational frustration and conductivity—offering a design principle for faster solid electrolytes.
🏷 solid acid electrolyte · proton conduction · machine-learning MD · polyanion rotation · proton slingshot

item.title: Monomer Molecule Reconstruction Engineered Heterogeneous Lithium‐Ion Solvation for High‐Performance Lithium‐Metal Batteries
item.description:

Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 In situ polymerization of IBMA amplifies steric hindrance, weakening Li⁺–polymer coordination and enabling anion-rich solvation at low salt concentrations. This molecule-reconstruction strategy, aided by TTE as a molecular lubricant, yields a gel electrolyte with 1.77 mS cm⁻¹ conductivity, 4.7 V stability, and 386.1 Wh kg⁻¹ pouch cells, establishing macromolecular backbone engineering as a general design principle for high-energy lithium-metal batteries.
